raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

For a chat request with images, video or audio, the OpenAI chat handler does this today:

1. It renders the chat template.
2. It encodes the result and decodes it back to text.
3. The multimodal processor then tokenizes that text again.

For long multimodal prompts, the extra encode and decode in step 2 is serial work in the tokenizer process, and its result is thrown away. We measured it at about 31 ms per 16K-token video chat request. When the text round trip is the identity, sending the rendered template directly gives the processor the same text.

## Modifications

- `SGLANG_CHAT_MM_SKIP_PROMPT_REENCODE` in `environ.py` (default off).
- `OpenAIServingChat._apply_jinja_template`: the handler renders the template with `tokenize=False` and sends it as the prompt with empty `prompt_ids` only when all of these hold:
  - the variable is on;
  - the request has media;
  - there are no tools and no assistant prefix;
  - the tokenizer's text round trip is not lossy (the existing `_prompt_text_round_trip_is_lossy` probe).

  Every other request, and every request with the variable off, takes the current path.
- Tests in `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/openai/test_serving_chat.py`: with the variable on, the rendered template is sent without encode/decode; with the default (off), the current path is kept.

## Accuracy Tests

From a clean checkout (CPU):

```bash
python3 test/registered/unit/entrypoints/openai/test_serving_chat.py
```

This passed on a downstream fork whose `python/` and `test/` trees match this repository's layout. The patch applies cleanly to this repository's main.

On an earlier version of this change, with an internal multimodal model:

- Greedy outputs with the variable on and off were identical on 8/8 multimodal requests, with equal prompt token counts.
- A prompt re-encode check matched on 16/16 requests.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Measured on an earlier version of this change, with the same model:

- The change removes about 31 ms of serial tokenizer-process work per 16K-token video chat request.
- Measured together with the SHM change (separate PR) and processor-side changes, first-wave TTFT P50 went from 8.2 s to 4.1 s. Throughput did not change, because the workload is device-bound.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -2196,15 +2196,37 @@ def _apply_jinja_template(
                 if self._tokenizer_auto_adds_specials or add_special_tokens
                 else {}
             )
+            skip_reencode = (
+                envs.SGLANG_CHAT_MM_SKIP_PROMPT_REENCODE.get()
+                and is_multimodal
+                and bool(image_data or video_data or audio_data)
+                and not tools
+                and not assistant_prefix
+                and not self._prompt_text_round_trip_is_lossy
+                and not add_special_tokens
+            )
             try:
-                prompt_ids, decoded_prompt = self._render_and_encode_chat_template(
-                    openai_compatible_messages,
-                    tools=tools,
-                    template_kwargs=extra_template_kwargs,
-                    encode_kwargs=encode_kwargs,
-                    use_cache=is_multimodal,
-                    add_generation_prompt=add_generation_prompt is not False,
-                )
+                if skip_reencode:
+                    prompt_ids = []
+                    decoded_prompt = (
+                        self.tokenizer_manager.tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
+                            openai_compatible_messages,
+                            tokenize=False,
+                            add_generation_prompt=add_generation_prompt is not False,
+                            tools=None,
+                            return_dict=False,
+                            **extra_template_kwargs,
+                        )
+                    )
+                else:
+                    prompt_ids, decoded_prompt = self._render_and_encode_chat_template(
+                        openai_compatible_messages,
+                        tools=tools,
+                        template_kwargs=extra_template_kwargs,
+                        encode_kwargs=encode_kwargs,
+                        use_cache=is_multimodal,
+                        add_generation_prompt=add_generation_prompt is not False,
+                    )
             except Exception:
                 # If the first attempt fails, try with flat function-only format.
                 # Some templates (e.g. Mistral) expect tools without the OpenAI wrapper.

@@ -1715,6 +1715,11 @@ class Envs:
     SGLANG_PARALLEL_PROMPT_ENCODE_MIN_CHARS = EnvInt(32768)
     SGLANG_REQUEST_STATE_WAIT_TIMEOUT = EnvInt(4)
     SGLANG_DEFAULT_THINKING = EnvBool(False)
+    # Chat requests with media: send the rendered chat template as the prompt
+    # instead of encode() + decode() of it; the MM processor tokenizes the text
+    # again anyway. Only when the text round trip is not lossy and there are no
+    # tools and no assistant prefix, where the round trip is the identity.
+    SGLANG_CHAT_MM_SKIP_PROMPT_REENCODE = EnvBool(False)
 
     # ===================================================================
     # Encoder pipeline and disaggregation

@@ -2794,6 +2794,55 @@ def test_dsv_tool_choice_none_omits_tools_from_prompt(self):
                 prompt = self.tm.tokenizer.encode.call_args.args[0]
                 self.assertEqual("calculator" in prompt, expects_tools)
 
+    def _mm_request(self):
+        self.template_manager.jinja_template_content_format = "openai"
+        return ChatCompletionRequest(
+            model="x",
+            messages=[
+                {
+                    "role": "user",
+                    "content": [
+                        {"type": "text", "text": "Describe"},
+                        {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "image-1"}},
+                    ],
+                }
+            ],
+        )
+
+    def test_mm_skip_prompt_reencode_sends_the_rendered_template(self):
+        self.tm.model_config.is_multimodal = True
+        self.chat._prompt_text_round_trip_is_lossy = False
+        self.tm.tokenizer.apply_chat_template.return_value = "<rendered>"
+        render_and_encode = Mock(return_value=([1, 2], "<decoded>"))
+        self.chat._render_and_encode_chat_template = render_and_encode
+
+        with patch.dict("os.environ", {"SGLANG_CHAT_MM_SKIP_PROMPT_REENCODE": "1"}):
+            result = self.chat._apply_jinja_template(
+                self._mm_request(), None, is_multimodal=True
+            )
+
+        render_and_encode.assert_not_called()
+        self.assertFalse(
+            self.tm.tokenizer.apply_chat_template.call_args.kwargs["tokenize"]
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(result.prompt, "<rendered>")
+        self.assertEqual(result.prompt_ids, [])
+
+    def test_mm_skip_prompt_reencode_is_off_by_default(self):
+        self.tm.model_config.is_multimodal = True
+        self.chat._prompt_text_round_trip_is_lossy = False
+        render_and_encode = Mock(return_value=([1, 2], "<decoded>"))
+        self.chat._render_and_encode_chat_template = render_and_encode
+
+        with patch.dict("os.environ", {"SGLANG_CHAT_MM_SKIP_PROMPT_REENCODE": "0"}):
+            result = self.chat._apply_jinja_template(
+                self._mm_request(), None, is_multimodal=True
+            )
+
+        render_and_encode.assert_called_once()
+        self.assertEqual(result.prompt, "<decoded>")
+        self.assertEqual(result.prompt_ids, [1, 2])
+
     def test_kimi_k3_encoder_receives_wire_request_fields(self):
         self.template_manager.chat_template_name = None
         self.chat.chat_encoding_spec = "kimi_k3"
